items.title: Alex Consani, Nicky Hilton, Ziwe, More Attend the Gucci x Moda Operandi Cocktail
items.summary: WWD covers the Nov 11 Gucci x Moda Operandi cocktail at Oriana in NYC's Nolita, hosted by Lauren Santo Domingo to launch the GucciCore trunk show; attendees including Alex Consani and Nicky Hilton Rothschild praised the collection's Y2K-inflected, 'sexy, fun, unapologetic' energy on the record.

items.title: At the LACMA Art+Film Gala 2026, Demna's Gucci Steps Into the Spotlight
items.summary: W Magazine's recap of the Nov 7 Gucci-presented LACMA Art+Film Gala (600+ guests, ~$7M raised for the museum) notes Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini attended alongside Kering chairman Francois-Henri Pinault, with the house dressing numerous A-list guests for Hollywood's biggest fundraising night.

items.title: Kering Slides as Gucci Sales Fall 6% Despite In-Line Q3 Revenue
items.summary: Wire coverage, still being cited in this week's analyst commentary, details how Kering shares slumped roughly 12% after Gucci's Q3 comparable sales fell 6% (worse than the ~5.4% consensus), with retail sales down 9% on weak China/Japan traffic; CEO Luca de Meo called the Gucci recovery the group's 'defining priority.'

items.source: TikTok (public comments, via Yahoo Entertainment roundup)
items.title: TikTok users call Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday ad 'depressing' and 'outdated'
items.summary: Still-circulating TikTok backlash against the Harmony Korine-directed 'Gucci Gift' holiday film: user @oldloserinbrooklyn wrote the ad 'feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury'; other comments called it 'cold,' 'emotionless' and said it 'feels outdated,' pushback distinct from the brand's intended festive tone.

items.title: Public reply threads under Gucci's official X posts remain split on Demna-era direction
items.summary: Reply threads under recent official @gucci posts continue to show a split public reaction: fans engaging with celebrity/ambassador casting (e.g. BTS Jin in custom Gucci) alongside a recurring undercurrent of commenters saying the house has become 'tasteless' or lost its former luxe read under Demna.

items.title: Forum Buzz: Alex Consani, Gabrriette & Others Front Demna's 'Trash' 2026 Generation Gucci Campaign
items.summary: theFashionSpot's forum-buzz desk aggregates fashion-forum member reaction to a Demna-era Gucci campaign fronted by Alex Consani and Gabrriette; sentiment is mixed, with praise for the model casting offset by continued community skepticism about creative coherence under Demna.

items.title: Demna's New LA FAMIGLIA Has Dropped. Will You be Buying?
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members debate whether to buy into Demna's LA FAMIGLIA line; page could not be fully fetched (403) but thread title and search-indexed snippets indicate an ongoing split between collectors open to the new direction and longtime members holding off, consistent with the forum's broader price/quality-skepticism thread also running since August.

items.title: Gucci price increase thread *please state location* (ongoing, NA members posting)
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread tracking Gucci price increases by model continues to draw fresh posts from US/Canada members (most recent indexed page dated into November); recurring theme is that repeated price hikes on Marmont, Horsebit 1955 and Dionysus styles have outpaced perceived quality or design payoff, feeding resale-value skepticism.

items.title: Parker Posey Captures Old School Glamour in Gucci at the LACMA Gala 2026
items.summary: Celebrity-style coverage of Parker Posey's caftan-style Gucci gown at the LACMA Art+Film Gala, framed favorably as evoking old Hollywood glamour; part of a wave of positive red-carpet coverage from the gala that also dressed Kim Kardashian, Timothee Chalamet and others in Gucci.
